askBody: Once connected, your AI teammates can run tasks on this device. You can change this, and which teams it serves, in Settings → This device
askMacTools: The first time, macOS may ask to install the Command Line Developer Tools, which takes a few minutes
doneHint: You can change all of this later in Settings → This device

failed.busy: This device is already connecting. Try again later
failed.removeOld: The old connector wasn't removed, so this device can't connect
failed.start: The device couldn't reach the platform. Check the network and try again
failed.tools: The Command Line Developer Tools aren't installed yet. Install them, then try again

hint.runtime: The first time takes a few minutes to download
hint.tools: Click Install in the window macOS opens; this continues once it is done

step.tools: Install the Command Line Developer Tools
